infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: TerminalX connects directly to a Mac you choose to pair.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow TerminalX to attach the photos you choose to a message for your agent.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow TerminalX to hear what you dictate to your agent.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow TerminalX to turn what you dictate into a message for your agent.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow TerminalX to scan a pairing code shown on your Mac.
